text:
sara-marketing: Ok team 1 I'm building the launch playbook: social launch posts, webinar invite, and landing page (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need short benchmark bullets, hero microcopy, and the inbound lead routing plan. Target: copy v1 by end of day Wednesday. Anyone object?

javier-growth: No objections. Suggest 3 social angles: 1) performance (benchmarks), 2) cost efficiency, 3) operational reliability. Each should have a 1-line hook per product mode.

emily-prod: Will export the perf sheet tomorrow AM. KPIs to surface: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec at batch sizes 1/8/32, and illustrative cost per 1k tokens at default config. Also add a note about fallback strategy for Private.

mike-ux: For hero we should split test tone: "Developer-first: ship features, not inference ops" vs "Enterprise-grade: predictable capacity with SLAs". Two hero variants + one neutral technical micro-hero.

linda-content: Draft hero candidates: Hosted: "Start serving models in minutes 14" sub: "Simple API, streaming, usage analytics." Dedicated: "Committed GPU pools for production" sub: "Predictable throughput and isolation." Private: "Bring inference inside your network" sub: "VPC or on-prem with KMS/HSM support."

sara-marketing: Nice. Let's A/B the developer-first vs enterprise-grade phrasing across all three mode pages. Also want a 2-line subhead under hero focusing on benefit + CTA.

rachel-sales: Inbound routing plan: webinar and landing registrations capture hidden fields: `product_mode`, `use_case`, `lead_intent`. Hot leads go to AE queue; others to nurture. Add a small checkbox "Interested in Private deployment" to surface compliance-driven prospects.

tom-ops: Technically doable. Recommend we also capture UTMs and a `page_variant` field. Example hidden input: <input type="hidden" name="product_mode" value="dedicated">. We'll instrument with retries for our webhook.

javier-growth: We should include a compact benchmark card on the landing: three cells: Median latency | Throughput (tok/s) | Estimated cost/1k. Keep numbers rounded for readability. That card also fuels social posts.

chris-analytics: I'll publish an event spec: `event_name=webinar_signup`, properties: [`product_mode`, `use_case`, `lead_score`, `utm_source`]. Lead_score (stringified number) computed from company_size, job_title, and use_case. We'll expose lead_score to the routing rule.

karen-corp: Webinar agenda proposal: 1) Benchmarks & real traces (Emily), 2) Serving levers: batching/caching/quantization (Ahmed), 3) Migration and rollouts (Sara + Customer inset). Keep it 45 minutes: 30m presentation + 15m live Q&A.

linda-content: Social copy options: "Live: Hosted vs Dedicated benchmarks 11 Join our webinar for real numbers + tradeoffs. [link]" and "Migrating to production? Watch our demo on predictable throughput + cost controls. [link]"

sara-marketing: Conversion flow proposal: Register -> Confirm email -> Attend -> Post-webinar follow-up email (trial + benchmark whitepaper). Capture `product_mode` at registration and include in follow-ups.

mike-ux: I'll mock the registration flow and confirmation modal with an accessibility-first layout. Pushing frames to Figma by noon; adding a privacy-first variant for Private mode (explicit disclosure and KMS mention).

rachel-sales: Routing rules suggestion: If lead_score >= 70 AND product_mode in (dedicated, private) -> tag SF record and notify AE channel with 2-hour SLA. Else -> add to nurture drip. AE outreach window = 48hrs.

tom-ops: We'll add `sf_campaign=launch_webinar_hot` on webhook payload. Also build a small lambda to retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff for SF sync.

linda-content: Micro-CTAs for each mode: Hosted CTA: "Try hosted API" Dedicated CTA: "Request reserved capacity" Private CTA: "Speak to an engineer". Short benefit bullets underneath (1-2 bullet lines each).

chris-analytics: I'll make the event names and properties available in the analytics workspace and create a dashboard for webinar funnel conversion, hot-lead conversion, and channel performance (utm_source). Will also add a cohort for "Private interest".

sara-marketing: Meeting: copy sprint tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize hero and social. @mike-ux @linda-content @javier-growth @chris-analytics please confirm.

mike-ux: In.

javier-growth: In.

chris-analytics: In.

emily-prod: I'll bring the benchmark CSV and a few graphs.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Launch Playbook: Copy Sprint" tomorrow 09:30 PT. https://calendar.example.com/events/launch-playbook-123 :calendar:

sara-marketing: One final copy ask: add a short footer line about graceful degradation: "If capacity is constrained, requests may transparently fall back to compatible model variants to preserve availability." That handles expectations.

tom-ops: Will add to global footer and the FAQ for Hosted and Dedicated pages. Also include a link to our fallback docs.

rachel-sales: Love it. Thanks team thumbsupf Everyone feel free to drop quick wire copy in this thread before EOD.
